calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, s.store_id < 900 AS is_store, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class,
       count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) calc_gross,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatches
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT 'dupe_ids' k, count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dupe_receipt_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'date_mismatch_helsinki', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND channel_code='ST' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'vat255_before_sep1', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date < DATE '2024-09-01' AND vat_rate=0.255
UNION ALL SELECT 'vat24_from_sep1', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AND sale_date<=DATE '2024-09-30' AND vat_rate=0.24
UNION ALL SELECT 'rows_gross_null', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND (gross_amount IS NULL OR net_amount IS NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'channel_codes_'||coalesce(channel_code,'null'), count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY channel_code
UNION ALL SELECT 'etl_distinct', count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

WITH a AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY ALL),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id, net_sales_before_returns nb FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT date_trunc('month', coalesce(a.d, r.d)) m, sum(a.net) mine, sum(r.nb) ctrl, sum(a.gross) gross,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(coalesce(a.net,0)-coalesce(r.nb,0))>0.05) nbad, count(*) n
FROM a FULL JOIN r ON a.d=r.d AND a.store_id=r.store_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
